source.title: Pathfinder #155: Lord of the Black Sands

items.name: Golem Antimagic
items.text:
Harmed by acid (6d10 untyped, 2d8 untyped from areas or persistent damage); healed by fire (area 2d8 healing HP); slowed by electricity

---

items.name: Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison
items.text: Casting Cleanse Affliction on the golem deactivates its Breath Weapon for 1 minute.

items.name: Vulnerable to Rust
items.text: Magical rusting effects, like a rust monster's antennae, affect the iron golem normally.

items.name: Breath Weapon
items.text:
The iron golem exhales poisonous gas in a 10-foot radius centered on the corner of one of the iron golem's squares.

The gas persists for 1 round. Any creature in the area (or that later enters the area) is exposed to the iron golem's poison.

The golem can't use its Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Inexorable March
items.text: The iron golem Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a DC 39 Fortitude save save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise, it is damaged as if hit by the golem's fist.

items.name: Iron Golem Poison
items.text:
Any Drained value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour.

Saving Throw DC 35 Fortitude save

---

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 2d6 poison damage and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 4d6 poison damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 8d6 poison damage and Drained 3 (1 round)
